selectionRule: Author-selected DM0.5 success and timeout examples on familiar tasks with the SONIC controller. Manifest labels are checked against video filenames. Full evaluation counts come from the paper's per-task CSVs (20 trials per task and condition), not from this selected video collection. The export does not include results.json, genuine-success flags, or recorded step counts.

metadataSources.outcomes: Author-supplied manifest labels, checked against success/timeout filenames; results.json is not included in this export.
metadataSources.sourceCounts: Author-supplied paper_data_20261017 per-task CSVs, matched by task ID and condition.
metadataSources.taskCategories: Public settings follow the paper's canonical Atomic/Compositional task classes, including two reclassified tasks. Private provenance and stable IDs preserve the original video folder paths.
